content.user_title: Create MaxArt Image and Video Prompts
content.value_statement: Creative briefs often need clear visual prompts before rendering. This skill turns briefs and references into MaxArt-ready prompt packs, motion plans, and testing ideas.
actual_capabilities: Extracts goals, audience, format, aspect ratio, style, brand constraints, and calls to action from a creative brief.
Creates three to five core image prompts and three to five variation prompts for MaxArt.ai rendering.
Writes image-to-video motion plans with opener, camera movement, subject motion, pacing, and ending frame.
Adds negative constraints for common generation issues such as warped hands, broken logos, and text artifacts.
Adapts prompt packs for campaign assets, social formats, product shots, and channel-specific creative testing.
Provides short production notes that identify what to test next in MaxArt.ai.
limitations: Does not render images or videos directly.
Does not promise exact MaxArt.ai controls or undocumented platform features.
Cannot guarantee perfect text, logos, hands, faces, or product geometry in generated outputs.
Requires the user to provide brand details, reference assets, or clear assumptions for best results.

use_cases.title: Build Product Launch Prompts
use_cases.description: Create hero image prompts, variation angles, negative constraints, and testing notes for a new ecommerce product.

use_cases.title: Plan Social Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign idea into short-form video scene directions with motion, camera, pacing, and CTA frames.

use_cases.title: Transform Reference Images
use_cases.description: Define what must stay fixed and what can change when adapting a reference asset into a new visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Image Pack
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one visual concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a MaxArt-ready image prompt pack for [product or subject]. Include a short creative direction, three core prompts, three variations, negative constraints, and one testing note.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Reference Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Reference image transformation with identity or product constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare MaxArt prompts for transforming my reference image. Preserve [identity, product shape, logo, or layout], change [style, setting, palette, or lighting], and list likely failure points.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Image-to-Video Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate motion direction from a keyframe or still image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image-to-video motion plan for [scene or asset]. Include opening frame, camera movement, subject motion, background motion, pacing, ending frame, and two variant directions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Campaign Prompt System
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this campaign brief into a MaxArt prompt system: [brief]. Include master visual direction, hero prompts, supporting assets, short video concepts, per-channel adaptations, and a testing matrix.

output_examples.input: A skincare brand needs premium launch visuals for a new serum bottle.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a polished product photography direction, multiple hero prompts, variation prompts for lighting and background, negative constraints, and a crop testing note.

output_examples.input: A creator has a portrait and wants a cinematic image-to-video prompt.
output_examples.output: The skill defines the opening frame, slow camera move, subtle subject motion, background motion, pacing, ending frame, and alternate motion directions.

output_examples.input: A team needs social ads for an AI design tool.
output_examples.output: The skill creates ad-friendly lifestyle prompts, CTA frame ideas, format adaptations, and a focused testing matrix for audience and style variations.

best_practices: Provide the product, audience, format, aspect ratio, brand constraints, and desired visual style.
Separate core prompts from variations so each test changes only a few visual dimensions.
Use negative constraints to protect logos, product geometry, facial structure, and readable composition.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for every possible style in one prompt.
Do not rely on vague quality words without concrete visual details.
Do not expect generated text, logos, or exact UI elements to render perfectly without post-production.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images inside MaxArt.ai?
faq.answer: No. It prepares prompts, motion plans, and production notes for use in MaxArt.ai.

faq.question: Can it work from a reference image?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define what should stay fixed, what can change, and which generation issues to watch for.

faq.question: What types of assets does it support?
faq.answer: It supports product shots, social ads, campaign visuals, stylized edits, and image-to-video creative directions.

faq.question: Does it support marketing copy?
faq.answer: It can suggest hooks, captions, and CTAs when the creative request is marketing-oriented.

faq.question: Will it use undocumented MaxArt.ai features?
faq.answer: No. The instructions explicitly avoid promising exact controls or undocumented platform features.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
